response.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS leftover FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(leftover) AS overall_avg FROM l) SELECT l.event_status, AVG(l.leftover) AS avg_leftover, AVG(l.leftover) - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM l CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.event_status, o.overall_avg
